mapper.select: SELECT id,region,title_type AS `titleType`,name,tax_no AS `taxNo`,email,is_default AS `isDefault`, created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM invoice_title WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,region,order_id AS `orderId`,title_id AS `titleId`,amount,tax_amount AS `taxAmount`,currency,status, invoice_no AS `invoiceNo`,reject_reason AS `rejectReason`,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM invoice_request WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,region,shop_id AS `shopId`,subject,content,status,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM support_ticket WHERE requester_type=1 AND requester_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT m.id,t.region,m.ticket_id AS `ticketId`,m.sender_type AS `senderType`,m.content,m.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM ticket_message m JOIN support_ticket t ON t.id=m.ticket_id WHERE t.requester_type=1 AND t.requester_id=#{userId} ORDER BY m.id

SELECT id,region,shop_id AS `shopId`,last_message AS `lastMessage`,last_message_at AS `lastMessageAt`, user_unread AS `userUnread`,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM consult_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT m.id,m.region,m.session_id AS `sessionId`,m.sender_type AS `senderType`,m.content,m.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM consult_message m JOIN consult_session s ON s.id=m.session_id AND s.region=m.region WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY m.id

SELECT id,region,shop_id AS `shopId`,table_type AS `tableType`,party_size AS `partySize`,queue_no AS `queueNo`, status,called_at AS `calledAt`,seated_at AS `seatedAt`,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM waitlist_entry WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,region,review_id AS `reviewId`,target_lang AS `targetLang`,content,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM review_translation WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,template_id AS `templateId`,region,type,threshold_amount AS `thresholdAmount`,discount_amount AS `discountAmount`, currency,shop_id AS `shopId`,status,used_order_id AS `usedOrderId`,used_at AS `usedAt`,expire_at AS `expireAt`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,region,ticket_no AS `ticketNo`,shop_id AS `shopId`,order_id AS `orderId`,type,title,content,status, merchant_reply AS `merchantReply`,merchant_replied_at AS `merchantRepliedAt`,resolution, resolved_at AS `resolvedAt`,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM complaint_ticket WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT l.id,t.region,l.ticket_id AS `ticketId`,l.actor_type AS `actorType`,l.action,l.remark,l.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM complaint_log l JOIN complaint_ticket t ON t.id=l.ticket_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY l.id
SELECT id,region,shop_id AS `shopId`,content,answer_count AS `answerCount`,status,is_deleted AS `deleted`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM shop_question WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,region,question_id AS `questionId`,content,status,is_deleted AS `deleted`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM shop_answer WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,region,shop_id AS `shopId`,dish_id AS `dishId`,score,content,is_deleted AS `deleted`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM dish_review WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT c.id,c.region,c.task_id AS `taskId`,t.title,t.reward_points AS `rewardPoints`,c.status, c.created_at AS `createdAt`,c.completed_at AS `completedAt` FROM creator_task_claim c LEFT JOIN creator_task t ON t.id=c.task_id AND t.region=c.region WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id,c.region,c.event_id AS `eventId`,e.title,c.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM seckill_claim c LEFT JOIN seckill_event e ON e.id=c.event_id AND e.region=c.region WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT m.id,t.region,m.team_id AS `teamId`,t.campaign_id AS `campaignId`,t.status,t.member_count AS `memberCount`, CASE WHEN t.leader_user_id=#{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS `leader`,t.expire_at AS `expireAt`,m.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM groupbuy_member m JOIN groupbuy_team t ON t.id=m.team_id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY m.id

SELECT a.id,e.region,a.experiment_id AS `experimentId`,e.name,a.variant,a.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM experiment_assignment a JOIN experiment e ON e.id=a.experiment_id WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY a.id
SELECT id,region,event_type AS `eventType`,shop_id AS `shopId`,category_id AS `categoryId`,keyword,weight,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM user_behavior_event WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,policy_type AS `policyType`,version,locale,source,accepted_at AS `acceptedAt` FROM user_policy_accept_log WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,device_uid AS `deviceUid`,platform,app_version AS `appVersion`,status,last_active_at AS `lastActiveAt`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM user_device WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,status,refresh_expire_at AS `expiresAt`,created_at AS `createdAt`,updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM user_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,region,reason,status,reject_reason AS `rejectReason`,submitted_at AS `submittedAt`,audited_at AS `auditedAt`, effective_start_at AS `effectiveStartAt`,effective_end_at AS `effectiveEndAt`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM user_expert_certification WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,region,account,reason,status,reject_reason AS `rejectReason`,audited_at AS `auditedAt`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM user_ban_appeal WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,region,scene,biz_id AS `bizId`,decision,dispose_status AS `disposeStatus`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM risk_event WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,target_type AS `targetType`,target_id AS `targetId`,reason,status,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM message_report WHERE reporter_user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,blocked_user_id AS `blockedUserId`,created_at AS `createdAt` FROM user_block WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT p.id,p.order_id AS `orderId`,p.channel,p.amount,p.currency,p.status,p.created_at AS `createdAt`,p.updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM payment p JOIN `order` o ON o.id=p.order_id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY p.id

SELECT r.id,r.order_id AS `orderId`,r.amount,r.reason,r.status,r.audit_reason AS `auditReason`,r.channel, r.channel_status AS `channelStatus`,r.audited_at AS `auditedAt`,r.created_at AS `createdAt`,r.updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM refund r JOIN `order` o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT c.id,c.order_id AS `orderId`,c.code,c.status,c.expire_at AS `expireAt`,c.verify_at AS `verifyAt`,c.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM coupon c JOIN `order` o ON o.id=c.order_id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT l.id,l.reservation_id AS `reservationId`,l.action_type AS `actionType`,l.operator_type AS `operatorType`, l.from_status AS `fromStatus`,l.to_status AS `toStatus`,l.old_reserve_time AS `oldReserveTime`, l.new_reserve_time AS `newReserveTime`,l.remark,l.created_at AS `createdAt` FROM reservation_change_log l JOIN reservation r ON r.id=l.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_title SET user_id=0,name='已注销用户',tax_no='',email='',is_default=FALSE,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE invoice_request SET reject_reason='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE ticket_message SET sender_id=CASE WHEN sender_type=1 AND sender_id=#{userId} THEN 0 ELSE sender_id END, content='内容已因账号注销移除' WHERE (sender_type=1 AND sender_id=#{userId}) OR ticket_id IN (SELECT id FROM support_ticket WHERE requester_type=1 AND requester_id=#{userId})
UPDATE support_ticket SET requester_id=0,subject='已注销用户的工单',content='内容已因账号注销移除',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE requester_type=1 AND requester_id=#{userId}

UPDATE consult_message SET sender_id=CASE WHEN sender_type=1 AND sender_id=#{userId} THEN 0 ELSE sender_id END, content='内容已因账号注销移除' WHERE (sender_type=1 AND sender_id=#{userId}) OR session_id IN (SELECT id FROM consult_session WHERE user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE consult_session SET user_id=NULL,last_message='',user_unread=0,merchant_unread=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE complaint_log SET actor_id=CASE WHEN actor_type=1 AND actor_id=#{userId} THEN 0 ELSE actor_id END,remark='' WHERE (actor_type=1 AND actor_id=#{userId}) OR ticket_id IN (SELECT id FROM complaint_ticket WHERE user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE complaint_ticket SET user_id=0,title='已注销用户的投诉',content='内容已因账号注销移除',merchant_reply='',resolution='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE waitlist_entry SET user_id=0,status=CASE WHEN status IN(1,2) THEN 5 ELSE status END,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE shop_question SET user_id=0 WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE shop_answer SET user_id=0 WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE dish_review SET user_id=0 WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM creator_task_claim WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=1
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_task_claim SET user_id=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE risk_event SET user_id=NULL,device_fingerprint=NULL,ip=NULL,reason='',dispose_remark='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE device_fingerprint d SET user_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_fingerprint_user u WHERE u.region=d.region AND u.fingerprint=d.fingerprint), last_user_id=CASE WHEN last_user_id=#{userId} THEN NULL ELSE last_user_id END WHERE d.id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM device_fingerprint WHERE id=#{id} AND user_count=0 AND last_user_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT e.id FROM seckill_event e WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seckill_claim c WHERE c.event_id=e.id AND c.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY e.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_event SET sold=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seckill_claim WHERE event_id=#{id}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM groupbuy_team t WHERE t.leader_user_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM groupbuy_member m WHERE m.team_id=t.id AND m.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY t.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE groupbuy_team SET leader_user_id=CASE WHEN leader_user_id=#{userId} THEN COALESCE((SELECT MIN(user_id) FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{id}),0) ELSE leader_user_id END, member_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{id}), status=CASE WHEN status=1 AND (expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{id})) THEN 3 ELSE status END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM review r WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_like l WHERE l.review_id=r.id AND l.user_id=#{userId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_helpful_vote v WHERE v.review_id=r.id AND v.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY r.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET like_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_like WHERE review_id=#{id}),helpful_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_helpful_vote WHERE review_id=#{id}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM post p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_like l WHERE l.post_id=p.id AND l.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_id=#{id}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE review_comment_report SET reporter_user_id=NULL,reporter_user_name='已注销用户',reason='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reporter_user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE post_comment_report SET reporter_user_id=NULL,reporter_user_name='已注销用户',reason='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reporter_user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE message_report SET reason='' WHERE reporter_user_id=#{userId} OR (target_type=1 AND target_id IN(SELECT id FROM message WHERE from_user_id=#{userId} OR to_user_id=#{userId})) OR (target_type=2 AND target_id IN(SELECT id FROM conversation WHERE user_a=#{userId} OR user_b=#{userId}))
mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM reservation_slot s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.slot_id=s.id AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status IN(0,1)) ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation_change_log SET operator_id=CASE WHEN operator_type=1 AND operator_id=#{userId} THEN 0 ELSE operator_id END,remark='' WHERE (operator_type=1 AND operator_id=#{userId}) OR reservation_id IN(SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE reservation_slot SET reserved_count=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(people_count),0) FROM reservation WHERE slot_id=#{id} AND status IN(0,1)),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM points_product p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM points_exchange e WHERE e.product_id=p.id AND e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.status=0) ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE points_product SET stock=stock+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_exchange WHERE product_id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=0), exchange_count=GREATEST(0,exchange_count-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_exchange WHERE product_id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=0)),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE points_exchange SET status=2,remark='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=0
UPDATE points_exchange SET remark='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_coupon SET status=CASE WHEN status=1 THEN 3 ELSE status END WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE payment SET client_secret='',raw_response=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id IN(SELECT id FROM `order` WHERE user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE refund SET reason='',audit_reason='',channel_failure_reason='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id IN(SELECT id FROM `order` WHERE user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE coupon SET remind_status=3 WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_policy_accept_log SET request_ip='',user_agent='' WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_ban_appeal SET account='',reason='',reject_reason='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE automod_hit SET user_id=0,reason='' WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE ad_click_log SET user_id=0 WHERE user_id=#{userId}

UPDATE audit_log SET detail='' WHERE target=CONCAT('app_user:',#{userId}) OR target IN(SELECT CONCAT('points_exchange:',id) FROM points_exchange WHERE user_id=#{userId}) OR target IN(SELECT CONCAT('user_ban_appeal:',id) FROM user_ban_appeal WHERE user_id=#{userId}) OR target IN(SELECT CONCAT('user_appeal:',id) FROM user_ban_appeal WHERE user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE user_device SET user_id=0,device_uid=NULL,push_channel=0,push_token='',status=2,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE privacy_delete_task SET account_snapshot='',reason='',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE privacy_export_task SET status=5,fail_reason='',expire_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
